title: INSPECT CAMSHAFT HOUSINGS FOR FLATNESS / REPLACEMENT OF CAMSHAFT HOUSING OIL SEAL

content.description: Top view of camshaft housing showing multiple cam lobes in a row with contact surfaces

content.text: Using a precision straight edge and feeler gauge, check the surfaces contacting the cylinder head for warpage.
Maximum cylinder head surface warpage: 0.10 mm (0.0039 in.)
If warpage is greater than maximum, replace the housing.

content.description: Isometric view of camshaft housing with arrow pointing to oil seal location

content.text: REPLACEMENT OF CAMSHAFT HOUSING OIL SEAL
There are two ways of oil seal replacement.
1. IF CAMSHAFT IS REMOVED FROM CAMSHAFT HOUSING:
(a) Remove the oil seal from the camshaft housing.

items: Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

content.description: Installation of new oil seal using SST tool on camshaft housing

content.text: (b) Install the new oil seal on the camshaft housing.

items: Apply MP grease to the oil seal.
Using SST, install the new oil seal.

content.description: View of installed camshaft housing on cylinder head with oil seal and cut position detail diagram showing seal cross-section

content.text: 2. IF CAMSHAFT HOUSING IS INSTALLED ON CYLINDER HEAD:

items: As shown in the figure, cut off the oil seal lips.

content.description: Removal of oil seal using screwdriver with tape protection, showing prying action on installed seal

items: Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

content.text: Be careful not to damage the camshaft. Tape the screwdriver.

items: Check the contact surface of camshaft oil seal lip for cracks or damage.
